evidence.title: Bulk N01 Vennesla Campus: operator Q2 2026 physical construction update
evidence.excerpt: The operator reports current new-facility construction at N01 progressing to schedule and plot preparation underway. The statement describes physical work, not merely committed investment or forecast capacity.
